name: Buckeye: Espionage Outfit Used Equation Group Tools Prior to Shadow Brokers Leak | DoublePulsar Backdoor
description: Symantec has found evidence that the Buckeye cyber espionage group was using tools released by the Shadow Brokers in 2017 to gain access to target targets before they were shut down in mid-2017.

name: Buckeye: Espionage Outfit Used Equation Group Tools Prior to Shadow Brokers Leak
description: Windows zero day was exploited by Buckeye alongside Equation Group tools during 2016 attacks. Exploit and tools continued to be used after Buckeyes apparent disappearance in 2017. The Buckeye attack group was using Equation Group tools to gain persistent access to target organizations at least a year prior to the Shadow Brokers leak.

name: APT3 Uncovered: The code evolution of Pirpi
Buckeye cyberespionage group shifts gaze from US to Hong Kong
description: Buckeye (also known as APT3, Gothic Panda, UPS Team, and TG-0110) is a cyberespionage group that is believed to have been operating for well over half a decade. Traditionally, the group attacked organizations in the US as well as other targets. However, Buckeye’s focus appears to have changed as of June 2015, when the group began compromising political entities in Hong Kong. Since March 2016, the group has appeared to mostly focus on organizations in Hong Kong, sending malicious emails to targets as recently as August 4, and attempting to spread within compromised networks in order to steal information.
